result.reason: The clause reaches the preferred customer position: Company may terminate on 30 days’ written notice, including during an active Statement of Work, receives a functionally pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, and owes no termination penalty. Contractor cannot terminate while work remains outstanding and must provide 90 days’ notice, which is consistent with the permitted vendor fallback. The drafting is clear and preserves unrelated intent. However, the added right for Company to terminate a Statement of Work “in part” is broader than necessary to implement the playbook, so the redline is not strictly minimal.
